links.outcome: Accuracy of bibliographic references provided by ChatGPT
links.effect: Of 214 references, 70.1% correct, 12.1% inaccurate, and 17.8% non-existing.
links.quote: ChatGPT provided 214 bibliographic references: 70.1% correct, 12.1% inaccurate, and 17.8% non-existing.

links.outcome: Usefulness and error count of ChatGPT diagnostic answers to pathology scenarios
links.effect: Useful in 62.2% of cases; only 32.1% of outputs had no errors, the rest had at least one error (894 evaluations).
links.quote: ChatGPT provided useful answers in 62.2% of cases, and 32.1% of outputs contained no errors, while the remaining had at least one error.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's diagnostic accuracy and referencing ability using simulated clinico-pathological scenarios assessed by pathologists, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
